sources: American Diabetes Association (ADA) - Standards of Care 2024
World Health Organization (WHO) - Global Obesity Prevention Guidelines

avoid.rationale: Excessive glycemic load can cause rapid blood glucose spikes.

moderate.rationale: Standard per-meal limit for blood sugar management (45g-60g carbs).

avoid.rationale: High sodium and saturated fats increase vascular tension and cholesterol.

moderate.rationale: AHA recommends limiting sodium to under 2,300mg daily, ideally 1,500mg.

avoid.rationale: Extremely high calorie density exceeds single-meal weight management targets.

moderate.rationale: Moderate calorie density for sustainable weight loss (400-600 kcal range).
